name: SPY call spread variant: in the money, 60 days, take profit at 80%, 50% stop, above 200-day
note: From the tune, the smoothest family: every third Friday buy the $10 spread that costs $6.00, two monthly expirations out, close at $8.00 or when it has lost 50% of the debit, only above the 200-day average. Lower return, much smaller drops; both exits depend on the modelled marks, so this one leans on the model most.
